phrases.translation: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ sent this ˹Quran˺ down
phrases.text: God sent the whole Quran down in one piece to the lowest heaven on this night. Some said it came all at once and was then spread out over the years, and some said the first of it came then, and that twenty years lay between the beginning and the end.
This is the night in which God decrees the ordainment for the year. The commentators say it comes every Ramadan, and that on it permission is given to the pilgrims and their names are written down.

phrases.translation: And what will make you realize what the Night of Glory is
phrases.text: What has made you aware, O Muhammad, of how great a thing this night is, which is better than a thousand months.

phrases.translation: The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months
phrases.text: A deed done in this night is better than a deed done in a thousand months in which there is no such night. The commentators add that the deeds, the fasting and the night prayer in it are better than a thousand months.
phrases.ar: لَيۡلَةُ ٱلۡقَدۡرِ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡ أَلۡفِ شَهۡرٖ

phrases.translation: That night the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit
phrases.text: The angels descend on that night, and Gabriel with them, and he is the Spirit. The commentators add that the angels do not meet a believing man or woman without greeting them.

phrases.translation: descend, by the permission of their Lord, for every ˹decreed˺ matter
phrases.text: By the permission of their Lord, for every matter God has decreed for that year, such as provisions and the appointed length of life. Tabari takes this as the sound reading, in agreement with Qatada.

phrases.translation: It is all peace until the break of dawn
phrases.text: That night is free of all evil from its beginning until the dawn rises on it. The commentators say it is entirely good, and that no matter happens in it that is not peace. They also record that the reciters differ over the vowel in the word for the rising of the dawn.
